Vet-led dog health advice from Dr. Feargus McConnell 🐕‍🦺

Welcome to Ask Dr. Ferg's a veterinarian-led channel dedicated to helping dog owners keep their dogs healthier, happier, and living longer.

Dr. Feargus McConnell shares practical, evidence-based advice on dog health, nutrition, supplements, and disease prevention.

On this channel you’ll learn about:

• Dog allergies and itchy skin
• Gut health and probiotics for dogs
• Joint health and mobility
• Dog nutrition and supplements
• Preventing common dog diseases
• Understanding your dog’s symptoms

Dr. Ferg’s is a vet-founded pet health platform and premium dog supplement brand trusted by dog owners who want the best care for their dogs.

Subscribe for expert dog health advice and answers to real dog owner questions.

Learn more about Dr. Ferg’s pet health resources and supplements:
www.drfergs.com
